home.headline: A trusted procurement solution
home.desc: NEO BH grows with customers through a sustainable operating system and proven expertise.
business.headline:
It provides sustainable value with reliable public
procurement and professional solutions.
business.desc: Global companies deliver sustainable growth with technological innovation and solutions
obtain.desc: NEO BH aims to become a trusted procurement partner that contributes to improving public institutions' work efficiency and administrative services beyond just supplying goods. Through a sustainable procurement system, we create a virtuous cycle in which the public and private sectors grow together.
manufacturing.desc: Beyond simple manufacturing, NEO BH continues to build a partnership as a manufacturing partner that meets the quality, schedule, and responsibilities required by public institutions. Based on accumulated production experience and stable production capacity, we create the reliability and sustainability of public infrastructure together.
ai.desc: NEO BH aims to serve as an operating partner to increase efficiency and transparency across public procurement beyond simple system construction. It combines field-oriented understanding and technical capabilities to provide AI solutions that are practically helpful in the public procurement environment.
safety.desc: NEO BH is building a business structure with a global market in mind, with the goal of a solution business that is not limited to a single product but encompasses industrial safety as a whole. With field-oriented understanding and business operation experience, we want to grow into a sustainable global safety solution partner.
